commits.title: A recommending grid brings its own words: the grid view takes them as a prop

changes.how: Add the texts ContentGridView and Price read, so a client component can read them through `browserText()` (D212). Top-level keys move here from src/lib/messages/en.ts, written once (en.ts spreads `...enBrowser`, so `t()` still has them): `readMore`, `viewProduct`, `addToCart`, `adding`, `added`, `capped`, `goToCart`, `planConflict`, `tryAgain`, `unavailable`, `quantity`, `quantityLess`, `quantityMore`, `fromPrice`, `yourPrice`, `priorPrice`. Move only the TOP-LEVEL definition of each (en.ts has `added`, `capped`, `unavailable`, `quantity` and `tryAgain` more than once: the others are nested under other keys and stay). Skip a key that is already in the browser file. Add one new nested group `gridTile: { priceOnRequest: "Price on request", preorderPage: (date: string) => `Pre-order: expected to ship from ${date}`, groupChoose: (option: string) => `Choose: ${option}` }` (copy the exact strings from en-quotes.ts line 8, en.ts line 493 and en.ts line 968).

Delete the top-level definitions that moved to en-browser.ts (the spread `...enBrowser` at about line 15 supplies them). Point the three nested texts at the browser file so each string is written once: `preorder.page: enBrowser.gridTile.preorderPage` (line 493) and `group.choose: enBrowser.gridTile.groupChoose` (line 968). Also in src/lib/messages/en-quotes.ts add `import { enBrowser } from "./en-browser";` and change line 8 to `priceOnRequest: enBrowser.gridTile.priceOnRequest,`: en-browser.ts imports nothing, so this makes no cycle. Do the same in nb-quotes.ts, sv-quotes.ts and da-quotes.ts (line 5 of each) with `nbBrowser`, `svBrowser` and `daBrowser` from their own browser files, which import only a type from en-browser.ts.

The same move for each language: the sixteen top-level keys from nb.ts, sv.ts and da.ts into nb-browser.ts, sv-browser.ts and da-browser.ts, and the `gridTile` group with that language's own strings (from its `quotes.priceOnRequest`, `preorder.page` and `group.choose`). Then in src/lib/messages/nb.ts, sv.ts and da.ts delete the moved top-level definitions and point `preorder.page` and `group.choose` at the browser file's, as in en.ts. The catalogues' tests (every language holds every key of English) must pass without change.

Remove `import { t } from "@/lib/i18n";` (line 9) and the line `const m = t(data.lang);` (about line 63). Add to ContentGridView's props `m: GridWords` and export the type: `export type GridWords = Pick<BrowserMessages, "readMore" | "viewProduct" | "addToCart" | "adding" | "added" | "capped" | "goToCart" | "planConflict" | "tryAgain" | "unavailable" | "quantity" | "quantityLess" | "quantityMore" | "fromPrice" | "yourPrice" | "priorPrice" | "gridTile">;` with `import type { BrowserMessages } from "@/lib/browser-text";` (a type import only). Replace the three nested reads: `m.quotes.priceOnRequest` with `m.gridTile.priceOnRequest` (about line 193), `m.preorder.page(` with `m.gridTile.preorderPage(` (196), `m.group.choose(` with `m.gridTile.groupChoose(` (199). Hand `m` to the inner functions that used the outer `m` as they do today. The `<Price ... m={m} />` call (about line 189) stays; see the next change.

Narrow the type of Price's `m` prop to what it reads: `Pick<Messages, "fromPrice" | "yourPrice" | "priorPrice">` plus any other key the file reads through `m.` (`rg -n '\bm\.[a-zA-Z]+' -o src/components/price.tsx | sort -u`; today exactly those three). No behaviour changes; callers that pass the whole `t(lang)` still type-check.

Import `{ browserText } from "@/lib/browser-text"` and pass the words at the lazy view (about line 133): `<ContentGridView block={block} data={data} notices={notices} tiles={tiles} m={browserText(data.lang)} />`. browserText() also serves a language translated by AI (it reads the registered texts). Correct the comment at lines 14-15: the view is loaded when the shopper's products arrive and holds no whole language.

At each of the four `<ContentGridView` calls (about lines 42, 47, 71, 76) add `m={t(data.lang)}` (import `t` from `@/lib/i18n` if the file does not have it). This is a server file, so the whole language is fine here.

This is today's path; once step 2.2 has moved the storefront routes the file is src/app/s/[store]/[market]/(shop)/blog/blog-listing.tsx: edit whichever of the two exists (only one does). It is the only file of this step under the market folder. At the two `<ContentGridView` calls (about lines 164 and 242) add `m={m}` if the function has the store's messages as `m`, else `m={t(data.lang)}`.
At the two `<ContentGridView` calls (about lines 100 and 116) add `m={t(data.lang)}`.

The three unit tests that draw the view (content-grid-tile-fields.test.ts, content-grid-cards.test.ts, content-grid-custom.test.ts) and any other caller the type check names (the builder's canvas preview of a grid: `rg -n '<ContentGridView' src`) pass `m={t(data.lang)}` or `m={browserText(lang)}`. No expectation changes.

In the test that waits for the shopper's own tiles (the one with `Fordi du så på`), collect every script response from `page.goto(address)` on (`page.on("response", ...)` with `resourceType() === "script"`, keeping url, body text and the time it arrived) and note the moment the response to `/api/recommendations` arrives. After the tiles are visible and the network is idle, take the scripts that arrived after that moment and assert: their bodies together hold none of the four sentences `nettbutikk med levering i`, `webbutik med leverans i`, `webshop med levering i`, `online store delivering in` (the whole-language markers of e2e/performance.spec.ts line 63); none holds `ZodError`; and their total length is at most 335,000 bytes in this commit (649,561 before). Print the total with `console.log` so the figure is in the run's output.

Step 1.27 creates this file with the shape `{ pages: { layout, built, product, listing, cart }, laterChains: [14 pairs], adminWords, cookiePurposes, browserTextBytes: 34000 }`; laterChains holds, for `components/lazy/blocks` and `components/recommended-grid`, the pairs to lib/i18n, lib/page-content, zod and the four lib/messages languages, spelled as rel() prints them. The four browser-language files measured 32,864 bytes together on 12 November 2026. This commit moves about 2,500 bytes of words into them, so that test will fail. This is the one sanctioned raise: after the move run `wc -c src/lib/messages/*-browser.ts`, set `browserTextBytes` to the total rounded up to the next 500, and say in the decision row why (the words left a 318,693-byte download of all four languages). In the same file remove from `laterChains` the ten pairs this commit clears, the ones ending `=> lib/i18n` and the four ending `=> lib/messages/…` for each of components/recommended-grid and components/lazy/blocks, exactly as many as the scan test says are gone; keep the `=> zod` and `=> lib/page-content` pairs, which commit 2 removes.

commits.title: The grid view reaches no zod and no page model

changes.how: This commit needs judgement; the sequence is: (1) make this pure module with no zod import and no import of `./page-content`, and move into it from src/lib/page-content.ts the three helpers the view reads with the plain types and constants they need: `contentSides` (line 847), `frameStyle` (2488) and `gridImageShape` (2618), plus the `Sides` type. src/lib/page-content.ts re-exports them (`export { contentSides, frameStyle, gridImageShape, type Sides } from "./grid-view";`) so its other importers do not change. src/components/content-grid.tsx imports the three from `@/lib/grid-view` and `ContentGridBlock` as a type only. (2) src/lib/part-css.ts is the second chain (it imports `./brands` and `./gallery`, which import `./page-content`, and `./theme-elements`, `./typography` and `./colour`, which import zod): the view needs only `gridListStyle`. Move `gridListStyle` and what it calls into a module without those imports (`src/lib/grid-list-style.ts`), re-exported from part-css.ts. (3) `familyClassOf` and `textRoles` come from src/lib/typography.ts, whose line 1 imports zod: split the schemas into `src/lib/typography-schema.ts` as the written rule asks (`a module that has both plain helpers and schemas keeps its schemas in *-schema.ts beside it`), leaving typography.ts without zod; do the same for src/lib/colour.ts (`colour-schema.ts`) and src/lib/theme-elements.ts (`theme-elements-schema.ts`) only as far as the walk from content-grid.tsx still reaches zod. After each move run the scan and the type check. Stop when the walk from src/components/content-grid.tsx (following static imports and import()) reaches neither zod nor lib/page-content.

Step 1.27 made the walk follow import(). Add a test `the grid a recommending grid loads later reaches no zod, no page model and no whole language`: walk from src/components/content-grid.tsx with the file's walker and expect no chain to `zod`, `lib/page-content`, `lib/i18n` or `lib/messages/<lang>`. If step 1.27 left a shrinking list of known chains for this view, empty it here. Rewrite the header comment's sentence `(the recommended grid's), which this walk does not follow` to say the walk follows it.

Lower the total of commit 1 from 335,000 to 140,000 bytes and add to the markers a string only the page model holds (take one from src/lib/page-content.ts that appears in the built chunk, for example a zod error message of its schema; check with `rg -l` in .next/static/chunks that the marker is in today's grid chunks and not in the new ones).

do_not: Do not add `"use client"` to content-grid.tsx: it is the server's view too.
Do not make the server send drawn markup for the shopper's grid through a server function: server functions run one at a time per page and would queue behind an Add to cart.
Do not copy a string into two message files where one can point at the other; and do not change any string's words.
Do not delete an export from src/lib/page-content.ts, part-css.ts, typography.ts, colour.ts or theme-elements.ts: re-export what moves, many files import them.
Do not lazy-load the tile's Add to cart or any other form.
Do not raise the 335,000 or 140,000 figures.

executor_why: Commit 1 is mechanical and held by the type check, the catalogue tests and the bundle scan, but commit 2 says itself that it needs judgement: which helpers and schemas move into grid-view.ts, grid-list-style.ts and the *-schema.ts files, re-measured after each move, and when to stop.

Corrections: none of the nineteen texts is in a browser file today, and `quotes.priceOnRequest` lives in en-quotes.ts, not en.ts, so the brief adds a `gridTile` group and guards against an import cycle; BN-16 put the split of the page model with code review step 3.2 and a 335,000 target first, while the step's bar is 140,000, so the brief keeps both as two commits and says where a cheap run must stop.
